description: A cozy pixel-art office where every thread is a little worker: busy threads at their desks, planners at the whiteboard, threads that need you in the waiting room, idle ones chatting over coffee and having lunch together. A full-panel home screen with your providers' usage, an office TV, your real weather outside the windows, a dog, a technician, office events, festivals through the year, lots to click and chiptune-style sound.
